description: A ledger write answers the new entry's transaction ID only in the `x-ms-ccf-transaction-id` response header (the spec models it as a header but the converted model drops it); without it GetTransactionStatus, GetLedgerEntry and GetReceipt cannot address the write.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Transaction ID of the write (`x-ms-ccf-transaction-id`); poll GetTransactionStatus until it is `Committed`.
